100% of Century Financial Services, parent of New Mexico-based Century Bank.
The deal would create a combined banking organization with ~$3.3B in total assets.
Century Bank had $1.36B in assets, $1.23B in deposits, and $845M in gross loans as of June 30, 2026.
The transaction consideration consists of $70M in cash and 1.23M Bank7 shares, implying a transaction value of roughly $137M based on Bank7’s recent average share price.
Bank7 intends to retain the Century Bank name and brand following the transaction.

Bank7 said the whole-company acquisition is its preferred path, while its previously announced agreement to acquire a 71% controlling stake in Century remains in effect if the merger does not proceed.

title: Bank7 agrees to acquire Century Financial Services for ~$137M
